THE_INSTRUCTION_AND_HOW_IT_IS_HONOURED.what_that_overrides: CLAUDE.md rule 15(d), which forbids shipping an ungated structural change into a scored slot. The owner has reaffirmed after the concern was raised twice, so it is their decision and it is taken.
THE_INSTRUCTION_AND_HOW_IT_IS_HONOURED.what_it_does_NOT_override: rule 15(c), never ship a MEASURED REGRESSION. THE_SELECTION_RULE, in order, no discret: 1. ELIGIBILITY. An arm is eligible only if its kernel status is `complete` AND its 25-game level total is >= 30. The 30 floor is the REJECT boundary this project already uses, and it exists to stop a self-inflicted zero: polyphony would have shipped 0 levels.
2. RANK the eligible arms by total levels, DESCENDING.

3. TIE-BREAK on the ex-ft09 shipped-scorer mean, not the raw mean. Arm DD read +17.8 percent on the raw mean and MINUS 0.305 once ft09 was removed, and ft09 alone swings the 25-game mean by about 1.0. Any rule that ranks on the raw mean will be fooled by one game.
4. SECOND TIE-BREAK, if still level: prefer the arm with more games reaching level 2 or deeper, because rank 5 is already past the pure-breadth ceiling.
5. THIRD TIE-BREAK, if still level: prefer FF over DD2 over EE, the prior order fixed above before any result.

6. IF NO ARM IS ELIGIBLE, meaning every one is a measured zero or fails to complete, ship the incumbent and say so plainly. This is the only branch that does not carry new code, and it fires only when carrying new code would mean knowingly shipping a zero.

WHAT_IS_DELIBERATELY_NOT_IN_THE_RULE.no_significance_test: on a max-keeping public board a wrong promote costs 0.095 board points and a right one pays 0.205, so a candidate needs only about a 21 percent prior. Demanding significance from a bench with a ~12.6-level MDE would reject everything forever, which is how this project spent the last three weeks flat.
WHAT_IS_DELIBERATELY_NOT_IN_THE_RULE.no_variance_argument: never promote because a config is noisier. That rule promotes a null arm about 65 percent of the time.
WHAT_IS_DELIBERATELY_NOT_IN_THE_RULE.no_post_hoc_metric_choice: the metric is total levels, with the ex-ft09 mean as tie-break only. Both are fixed here, before the numbers exist.

MECHANICS.why_a_hand_submission_is_needed: the launchd job at 17:06 local ships whatever is in the ROTATION, and none of these arms is in it. The picker script submits first and writes the record file the launchd job checks, so the two cannot double-fire.

HONEST_STATEMENT_OF_RISK: This ships a config on n=1 from an instrument whose byte-identical reruns span 29 to 33 levels. The arm chosen may well be no better than the incumbent, and the draw may come back below 2.0. What it cannot do is lower our banked 2.65, because the public board keeps our maximum. The cost of being wrong is one day of information; the cost of never trying is the last three weeks.
